acceptance_checks: Entry wrapper locates raster guard, runtime guard injector, measurement identity injector, boundary binding injector and carrier in slot-scoped paths.
Raster guard receipt must PASS with version 1.0, eight checks and exact EA NoData sentinel.
Runtime guard injector self-test must PASS with version 1.2 and seventeen checks.
Runtime guard injector must add exactly four raster, probe and HMLR receipt patches.
Entry wrapper must verify all six declared probe runtime requirements.
Measurement identity injector self-test must PASS with version 1.1 and fifteen checks.
Measurement identity injector must add exactly five patches including native-BNG enforcement.
Measurement identity labels must include environment handoff, native BNG, column binding, candidate provenance and business-row provenance.
Measurement identity receipt must declare native_crs_required=EPSG:27700.
Measurement identity receipt must enumerate six rejected null-like polygon identifiers.
Boundary binding injector self-test must PASS with version 1.0 and ten checks.
Boundary binding injector must add exactly two patches: strict interior matcher and boundary-touch rejection.
Boundary binding receipt must declare strict_polygon_interior_only and reject_canonical_binding.
First-stage source/output paths, byte counts and SHA-256 values must match its receipt.
Second-stage source/output paths, byte counts and SHA-256 values must match its receipt.
Third-stage source/output paths, byte counts and SHA-256 values must match its receipt.
Second-stage source SHA-256 must equal first-stage output SHA-256.
Third-stage source SHA-256 must equal second-stage output SHA-256.
Only the final strict-interior carrier may be executed and its exit code must be propagated.
All six temporary carrier and receipt files must be removed in finally.
All network-capable Python components pass deterministic self-tests before network work.
All fifteen carrier/main-Python source replacements must match exactly once or execution stops.
Fetch current official HMLR page with a cookie jar and require exactly one Barking and Dagenham row.
Require the authority ZIP route to match London_Borough_of_Barking_and_Dagenham.zip exactly.
Require HTTPS and exact allowlisted HMLR or S3 final host and path.
Do not persist the short-lived signed query URL.
Require ZIP magic, safe paths, no encryption, no symlinks and bounded expansion.
Require exactly one non-empty GML member with independent ZIP and GML SHA-256.
Require native EPSG:27700 valid Polygon or MultiPolygon geometry with plausible BNG bounds.
Measurement must fail closed if the loaded GML CRS is not native EPSG:27700.
Measurement must never silently reproject an unverified HMLR GML.
Require one unique non-empty Land Registry-INSPIRE identifier per polygon and identifier-set hash.
Require the HMLR receipt identifier column name to contain both INSPIRE and ID semantics.
Reject generic id or gml_id columns as sufficient INSPIRE identity evidence.
Require HMLR receipt unique_identifier_count to equal feature_count.
Require a 64-character lowercase hexadecimal identifier-set SHA-256 in the HMLR receipt.
Pass the verified identifier column and identifier-set SHA-256 to measurement through exact named environment variables.
Measurement Python must select exactly the receipt-declared identifier column and no fallback column.
Measurement artifact polygon_id_column must equal the receipt-declared identifier column.
Candidate hmlr_identifier_column must equal the measurement identifier column.
Candidate hmlr_identifier_set_sha256 must be a valid 64-character lowercase hexadecimal digest.
Reject empty, nan, none, null, <na> and nat polygon identifiers before business-row promotion.
Verify persisted HMLR page and GML byte counts and hashes before handoff.
Run 11 official Composite OGC metadata queries and hash each response.
Build each primary metadata bbox from canonical BNG coordinates with explicit EPSG:27700 bbox-crs.
Request OGC response geometry explicitly in EPSG:27700.
Reject metadata responses with conflicting final host, content type, Content-Crs or BNG bounds.
Require exactly one local BNG geometry match for each point.
Require filename, tilename, polygon_id, resolution, year, survey dates and response/feature hashes.
Parse four-digit survey years as calendar years and require date consistency.
Run official time-stamped ArcGIS queries as secondary QA only.
Require each parcel DTM 10m service probe; DSM probe is optional QA.
A failed optional DSM QA request must not suppress factual DTM receipts.
Require every 10m probe raster to be EPSG:27700 and single-band.
Require every 10m probe raster pixel size to be approximately 1m in both axes.
Parse exactly one E and one N subset range from each prepared probe URL.
Require the returned probe raster bounds to cover the requested E/N BBOX within a 1.5-pixel tolerance.
Filter probe raster metadata NoData and official EA sentinel -3.4028235e38.
Require at least one finite non-NoData probe pixel before successful probe state.
Persist probe CRS, resolution, requested BBOX, raster bounds and valid-pixel count in the probe receipt.
Require classic TIFF II 42 or MM 42 and reject malformed headers and BigTIFF.
At full-polygon runtime filter raster metadata NoData and official EA sentinel before statistics.
Fail closed when no finite non-NoData full-polygon raster pixel remains.
Generate intersecting candidates only as a preliminary spatial-index filter.
Require the selected polygon geometry to contain the canonical point strictly in its interior.
Record interior_polygon_candidate_count and boundary_touch_candidate_count separately.
Reject any point touching one or more polygon boundaries as non-canonical.
Require exactly one strict-interior polygon after boundary-touch rejection.
Treat 15m proximity as candidate-only and never as canonical binding.
Hash exact polygon WKB.
Require full-polygon DTM as terrain evidence.
Attempt full-polygon DSM only as optional surface QA.
Require full-polygon DTM EPSG:27700, approximately 1m pixels, complete polygon coverage and finite pixels.
Compute height difference only as polygon DTM maximum minus minimum and record p95-p05 QA.
Require HMLR ZIP/GML, receipt-bound INSPIRE identity, strict-interior binding, polygon WKB, DTM and survey provenance before a business row.
Keep partial outputs factual, final_ready false and prepared/self-test rows excluded from numeric results.
Do not write database rows, run migrations or deploy production.
Do not claim runner execution until all four exact output files exist and validate.
Keep the task prepared_not_enqueued while the shared queue branch is unresolved.
Treat source-confidence percentages as source-selection metadata, never as parcel-result accuracy.
